01 / ProfileBeyond the spreadsheet
FIG. 02 / A MILESTONE, NOT A FINISH LINE

A curious mind.
A broader lens.

I'm Gifhari, a Master of Data Science graduate from Monash University, based in Melbourne.

My path into data hasn't been a straight line. I've studied business, worked in research and environmental consulting, and led a student organisation. Each experience taught me to look at challenges from another angle.

Today, I'm interested in work where analytical depth meets commercial thinking — and where the people behind the decisions are just as important as the numbers.

“I care about getting the analysis right. I care just as much about making it useful.”
02 / PerspectiveThe way I think

I start with why.

I connect analytical work with the decision it needs to support: define the question, test the evidence and communicate a practical next step.

Dialogue & community24 May 2026 · Monash College, Docklands
EVENT 01 / PPIA MONASH

300 Indonesians.
One shared future.

My role: PPIA Monash President

At the Australia–Indonesia Networking Forum, we brought together 300 Indonesians for conversation, connection and a shared look at Indonesia’s future. The event connected our community with H.E. Dr. Siswo Pramono and Ferry Irwandi.

300Indonesian attendees
2featured guest speakers
2026forum edition
The event +

The forum explored the role of young Indonesians abroad in Indonesia Emas 2045. It created room for students, professionals and emerging leaders to exchange perspectives through a panel discussion, questions and networking.

GUEST SPEAKER
H.E. Dr. Siswo Pramono

Ambassador of the Republic of Indonesia to Australia and Vanuatu at the time of the forum.

GUEST SPEAKER
Ferry Irwandi

Public educator and content creator.

MODERATOR
Dona Niagara Dinata

PhD candidate in Education at Monash University.

Discussion themes

Youth leadership, innovation, cross-cultural collaboration and the contribution of Indonesians living abroad to Indonesia Emas 2045.

Official event listing ↗Indonesian Consulate coverage ↗
My contribution +

My contribution spanned speaker coordination, delegation communication, sponsorship support and event execution with internal and external stakeholders. As PPIA Monash President, I helped connect the people and teams behind the forum.

Why it matters +

This event brought diplomacy, public dialogue and student leadership into the same room. For me, the work was about making a large community gathering purposeful: connecting people, coordinating stakeholders and creating space for discussion.
